keys.type: object with enabled (Boolean), checker ("aspell", "hunspell", "ispell", or "auto"), language (string, passed to the checker as its dictionary name), and color (string, a terminal color name, #rrggbb, rgb(r,g,b), ansi256(n), or ansi:<name>)
keys.default: unset, so spell checking is off; checker defaults to "auto", the first of the three found on PATH; language defaults to the checker's own dictionary; color defaults to the theme's error color

keys.summary: Hide tips in the spinner while Claude works
typeValues: true: you see tips in the spinner while Claude is working
false: Claude Code hides spinner tips

keys.scopeNote: Claude Code honors tip objects, tipsFile, label, and excludeDefault from user settings, the --settings flag, and managed settings; from project and local settings it reads plain string tips only.
keys.summary: Add your own tips to the spinner rotation, or replace the built-in tips
keys.type: object with tips, tipsFile, label, and excludeDefault fields, each optional
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code shows only the built-in tips

keys.summary: Add or replace the verbs shown while a turn runs
keys.type: object with a verbs array of strings and mode, one of:
typeValues: "append": Claude Code adds your verbs to the built-in set
"replace": Claude Code shows only your verbs
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the built-in verbs

keys.scopeNote: The desktop app reads this key. By default, it reads managed connections from one managed source.
keys.summary: Add SSH connections to the Desktop environment dropdown
keys.type: array of objects, each with required id, name, and sshHost and optional sshPort and sshIdentityFile

keys.scopeNote: By default, Desktop reads the key from one managed source.
keys.summary: Limit which hosts Desktop SSH sessions can reach
keys.default: unset, so any host is allowed

keys.scopeNote: When allowManagedHooksOnly is on, or disableAllHooks is set outside managed settings, only the managed settings value runs.
keys.summary: Run your own command to render a status line below the prompt
keys.type: object with type set to "command" and a command string, plus optional padding as a number of characters, refreshInterval as a number of seconds, minimum 1, and hideVimModeIndicator as a Boolean

keys.summary: Allowlist the marketplace sources users can add and install from
keys.type: array of marketplace source objects; see Allowed source types
keys.default: unset, so users can add any marketplace. An empty array is a complete lockdown that blocks every marketplace source, including the official Anthropic marketplace

keys.summary: Block skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers from user and project sources
keys.type: true to lock all four kinds of customization, or an array naming the kinds to lock, from "skills", "agents", "hooks", and "mcp"

keys.summary: Lock agents to plugin and managed sources
keys.type: the string "agents" in the strictPluginOnlyCustomization array

keys.summary: Lock hooks to plugin and managed sources
keys.type: the string "hooks" in the strictPluginOnlyCustomization array

keys.summary: Lock MCP servers to plugin and managed sources
keys.type: the string "mcp" in the strictPluginOnlyCustomization array

keys.summary: Lock skills to plugin and managed sources
keys.type: the string "skills" in the strictPluginOnlyCustomization array

keys.summary: Choose the prompt cache lifetime for subagents and other requests outside the main conversation
typeValues: "5m": the cache holds for five minutes
"1h": the cache holds for an hour
keys.default: unset, so each of these requests gets its default lifetime

keys.scopeNote: When allowManagedHooksOnly is on, or disableAllHooks is set outside managed settings, only the managed settings value runs.
keys.summary: Rewrite rows in the subagent task display with your own command
keys.type: object with type set to "command" and a command string
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code renders the default rows

keys.scopeNote: Appears in /config as Switch models when a message is flagged, with the options Switch automatically and Ask each time.
keys.summary: Switch models automatically or pause when a safety classifier flags a request
typeValues: true: Claude Code switches to the fallback model and continues
false: in an interactive session Claude Code pauses so you can choose between switching and editing the prompt; where no dialog can show, such as a -p run, the flagged request ends as an error
keys.default: unset. Claude Code switches automatically, though it may ask first in an interactive session

keys.scopeNote: and files passed with --settings. A repository can't turn it off for you.
keys.summary: Stop loading the plugins enabled on your claude.ai account and stop downloading new ones
typeValues: false: Claude Code stops downloading synced plugins and stops loading the ones already in ~/.claude/plugins/synced/. In user or managed settings, it also moves them to ~/.claude/plugins/.trash/
true: the same as unset
keys.default: unset, so sessions signed in with your claude.ai account sync your plugins

keys.scopeNote: and files passed with --settings. A repository can't turn it off for you.
keys.summary: Stop loading the skills enabled on your claude.ai account and stop downloading new ones
typeValues: false: Claude Code stops downloading synced skills and stops loading the ones already in ~/.claude/skills/synced/. In user or managed settings, it also moves them to ~/.claude/skills/.trash/
true: the same as unset
keys.default: unset, so sessions signed in with your claude.ai account sync your skills

keys.summary: Turn off syntax highlighting in diffs and code blocks
typeValues: true: Claude Code turns off syntax highlighting in diffs, code blocks, and file previews
false: Claude Code highlights syntax

keys.summary: Removed in v2.1.277, together with the TaskOutput tool it sized

keys.scopeNote: On v2.1.233 and earlier.
keys.summary: Removed in v2.1.234; see Specify teammates and models for how Claude Code picks a teammate's model
keys.type: string, a model alias or full model ID, or null

keys.scopeNote: Claude Code also reads a value left in ~/.claude.json by older versions.
keys.summary: Choose how agent team teammates display
typeValues: "in-process": teammates run inside your main terminal pane
"auto": split panes when you're running inside tmux, or inside iTerm2 with it2 on your PATH or tmux installed; in-process otherwise
"tmux": split panes using tmux or iTerm2, detected from your terminal
"iterm2": iTerm2 native split panes through the it2 CLI

keys.scopeNote: A value in ~/.claude.json from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.
keys.summary: Hide the terminal progress bar in terminals that support it
typeValues: true: you see the terminal progress bar in terminals that support it
false: Claude Code hides the terminal progress bar

keys.summary: Stop /rename and --name from changing the terminal tab title
typeValues: true: the terminal tab title shows the session name you set
false: the tab keeps the title Claude Code generates from your conversation

keys.scopeNote: A value in ~/.claude.json from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.
keys.summary: Pick the interface color theme, built-in or custom
typeValues: "auto": matches your terminal's light or dark background
"dark": the dark theme
"light": the light theme
"dark-daltonized": the dark theme with colorblind-friendly colors
"light-daltonized": the light theme with colorblind-friendly colors
"dark-ansi": the dark theme using only your terminal's ANSI color palette
"light-ansi": the light theme using only your terminal's ANSI color palette
"custom:<slug>" or "custom:<plugin-name>:<slug>": a custom theme from ~/.claude/themes/ or a plugin

keys.summary: Show the times in the interface on a 12-hour or 24-hour clock, in UTC, or with a strftime pattern
typeValues: "auto": the same as unset; each time keeps its built-in format, which follows your locale on the turn duration message
"12-hour": a 12-hour clock
"24-hour": a 24-hour clock
"24-hour-utc": a 24-hour clock in UTC with Z after the minutes, such as 18:05Z; Claude Code ignores timeZone for this preset
A strftime pattern such as "%H:%M": Claude Code writes each time with the pattern. Any value that contains a % is a pattern, and any other value outside the presets counts as "auto"

keys.summary: Show the times in the interface in a time zone other than your system's
keys.type: string, an IANA time zone name. When Claude Code doesn't recognize the name, it uses your system time zone
keys.default: unset, so times show in your system time zone

keys.summary: Choose the fullscreen or classic terminal renderer
typeValues: "default": the classic main-screen renderer
"fullscreen": the flicker-free alt-screen renderer with virtualized scrollback
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code picks the renderer for you

keys.summary: Have Claude plan a workflow for each substantive task without being asked
typeValues: true: sessions start with ultracode on when dynamic workflows are enabled for you and your model supports xhigh
false: sessions start with ultracode off

keys.scopeNote: A repository can't turn it off for you.
keys.summary: Let the auto mode classifier review shell commands in plan mode; set false to get prompts instead
typeValues: true: the same as unset; when auto mode is available, the classifier reviews each shell command during planning instead of prompting you for it, except critical-path removals. A false in any of these files still turns it off
false: you get a permission prompt for every command outside the built-in read-only set

keys.scopeNote: A value in ~/.claude.json from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.
keys.summary: Show full tool output instead of truncated summaries; viewMode takes precedence when both are set
typeValues: true: you see full tool output
false: you see truncated summaries of tool output

keys.summary: Start every session in default, verbose, or focus view
typeValues: "default": the normal transcript with truncated tool output
"verbose": the transcript with full tool output
"focus": only your last prompt, a one-line summary of tool calls with edit diffstats, and the final response. Focus view needs the fullscreen renderer
keys.default: unset, so the verbose setting and your last /focus choice apply

keys.scopeNote: A repository can't remap your keystrokes.
keys.summary: Map a two-key INSERT-mode sequence such as jj to Escape
keys.type: object mapping a two-character sequence to "<Esc>"

keys.summary: Turn on voice dictation and pick hold or tap mode
keys.type: object with enabled as a Boolean, autoSubmit as a Boolean that applies in hold mode only, and mode, one of:
typeValues: "hold": you hold the dictation key while speaking and release it to stop
"tap": you tap the key once to start recording and again to send
keys.default: unset, so dictation is off; when enabled is true and mode is unset, Claude Code uses "hold"

keys.summary: Turn on voice dictation with the older single-key form
typeValues: true: voice dictation is on when you're logged in with a claude.ai account and your organization's policy allows voice, unless voice.enabled is set
false: voice dictation is off, unless voice.enabled is set

keys.summary: Turn off mouse-wheel acceleration in fullscreen rendering
typeValues: true: Claude Code accelerates mouse-wheel scroll speed during fast scrolls
false: Claude Code scrolls at a constant rate per wheel notch

keys.scopeNote: Appears in /config as Ultracode keyword trigger.
keys.summary: Let the word ultracode in a prompt start a workflow; set false to type it without starting one
typeValues: true: typing ultracode in a prompt triggers a dynamic workflow
false: you can type the word without triggering one

keys.scopeNote: A value there takes precedence over the Dynamic workflow size choice in /config, which Claude Code stores in ~/.claude.json, and Claude Code hides that row while a settings file sets the key.
keys.summary: Set the agent count Claude aims for in dynamic workflows
typeValues: "unrestricted": no guideline, so Claude sizes the workflow to the task
"small": Claude aims for fewer than 5 agents
"medium": Claude aims for fewer than 10 agents
"large": Claude aims for fewer than 50 agents
keys.default: "medium", or "small" when you're signed in on a Pro plan with Claude Code v2.1.271 or later

keys.summary: Configure how Claude Code creates git worktrees
keys.type: object with baseRef, symlinkDirectories, sparsePaths, and bgIsolation

keys.summary: Branch new worktrees from the remote default branch or your local HEAD
typeValues: "fresh": new worktrees branch from origin/<default-branch>
"head": new worktrees branch from your current local HEAD, including unpushed commits

keys.summary: Let background sessions edit the working copy without a worktree
typeValues: "worktree": Claude Code blocks Edit and Write in the main checkout until the session calls EnterWorktree
"none": background jobs edit the working copy directly

keys.scopeNote: in ~/.claude/settings.json on the remote machine
keys.summary: Choose where Desktop SSH sessions create their worktrees on a remote machine
keys.type: string, an absolute path or one that starts with ~/
keys.default: unset, so worktrees go inside the project

keys.summary: Check out only the directories you need in each worktree
keys.type: array of strings, directory paths relative to the repository root
keys.default: unset, so each worktree checks out the whole tree

keys.summary: Symlink large directories into each worktree instead of duplicating them
keys.type: array of strings, directory paths relative to the repository root
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code symlinks no directories

keys.scopeNote: In an admin-controlled Windows source.
keys.summary: Have WSL read managed settings from the Windows policy chain
typeValues: true: Claude Code on WSL reads managed settings from the Windows policy chain, and reads /etc/claude-code only when no Windows admin document is present
false: WSL reads only /etc/claude-code
